notes.title: 1.12 Update, Achievements!
notes.notes:
[h1][u][b]Hello! Update 1.12 is out! [/b][/u][/h1]

[h2][u]Included in this update : [/u][/h2]

- Steam API integration
- 22x brand new Steam Achievements
- minor bug fixes

In the past months i've been working multiple different projects, including Warp Speed Infinity post -release development. I'm very proud to finally release the update that introduces Steam API integration! 

Steam API integration is needed for certain steam features like; Steam achievements, controller integration and much more. Long story short, this update paves the way for many great features that will be included in future development for Warp Speed Infinity!

Next to the API integration, i also added 22 new unique steam achievements! Some of them are very easy but some of them require insane skill and reflexes to achieve. 

I did my best to make the transition as smooth as can be but there's a small chance that some might experience issues with unlocking certain achievements due to previously achieved high scores. When this occurs it can be quickly fixed by a simple reset of the high scores in the main menu at the cost of losing one's progress. My apologies in advance if any of these issues arise. 


[h1][u][b]Future Development[/b][/u][/h1]

2024: Bugfixes, controller integration

2024-2025: Keybindings/controls overhaul, Steamdeck integration, additional ships, soundtrack DLC release, bugfixes

2026: Bugfixes, optimization, additional content

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
After much studying and thousands of hours of hard work i'm proud to announce i'm finally releasing my first title. Warp Speed Infinity.

Although i'm calling it full release, future updates will include; Steam Achievements, UI improvements, Controller integration, DLC and much more. 

I'm hard at work on my next game already too so it might take a while for these updates to start rolling in but they will come. 

Thank you all who are and have been supporting me, i couldn't have done this without you!




Arturnicus
